events.location: Musenyi refugee site, Burunga Province, southern Burundi
events.title: Congolese refugees demonstrate for voluntary repatriation
events.excerpt: une manifestation pacifique pour réclamer leur rapatriement volontaire vers la République démocratique du Congo
events.notes: Article explicitly locates the march at the refugee site in Burundi and dates it June 15. Participants are Congolese refugees, but the physical event was in Burundi; included on location basis.

excluded_or_unverified_leads.reason: A serious incident and public panic, but retrieved reporting attributes it to an electrical short circuit; it was not a strike, protest, or demonstration.

method_notes: Bounded search focused on strikes, public demonstrations, protests and rallies within the country in Apr-Jun 2026.
Local-language/French queries were used where feasible; Canada searched in English and French.
No-results wording does not claim absence. Planned actions, foreign-location protests, non-protest commemorations and diplomatic statements are not counted as public protest occurrences.
Publication and event dates are separate where established; uncertainty and provenance notes are explicit.
Quoted excerpts are bounded to fewer than 25 words per source.
This is a staging artifact only; scientific kit/schema integration remains pending.
